messages:
Maya Chen: paging: multiple customers reporting 502/504s from inference endpoints in us-east-2 (az-b). I see ELB 5xx spikes and TCP reset counts rising. :rotating_light:
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT ALERT: high 5xx rate detected on cluster inference-prod-us-east-2a (az-b). Trigger: ELB target unhealthy > 40% for 6m. PagerDuty: page sent to SRE Oncall.
Liam O'Connor: looking. Metrics show ENI attach failures + NET_TX drops on worker hosts in az-b, per cloudwatch. Could be eni saturation on hosts after recent scaling.
Olivia Park: confirmed from logs: kubelet showing `unable to attach network interface` errors  -> containers stuck in Pending networking.
Raj Patel: customer-impact: several large customers (batch inference) see requests failing; total 30% of traffic to this AZ impacted. We have auto-failover to other AZs but weighted routing still sending a chunk here.
Maya Chen: ok, immediate mitigation: switch Route53 routing policy to shift weights away from az-b. Who can run that?
Liam O'Connor: I can. Plan: update latency-based record set weights to 0 for az-b regional endpoints, allow DNS TTL 60s to propagate, then increase capacity in az-c/d. Also concurrently drain ELB targets in az-b so they stop receiving new connections.
Olivia Park: start draining target groups now. `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:... --targets Id=i-0abc` -> will cause current connections to finish.
DeployBot: deploy job #6543 paused due to 5xx spike.
Raj Patel: customers notified via status page? Ana, can you post a quick update?
Ana (CustSuccess): on it. Posting: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting inference in us-east-2. Traffic is being shifted to healthy AZs; minimal customer action required. Updates every 10 minutes." :loudspeaker:
Liam O'Connor: Route53 change applied: set weight 0 for az-b endpoints at 1767779060. TTL is 60. Expect reduced traffic to az-b ~ within 2 mins.
Maya Chen: draining target groups now and scaling up replacement hosts in az-c/d. `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name inference-us-east-2a-workers --desired-capacity 0` (drain) and scale group in az-c/d +10.
Olivia Park: adding a short-term NAT gateway replacement for instances failing ENI attach: creating ENI pool on hosts with lower attach counts as workaround.
SRE-Bot: NOTE: ENI attach throttles observed at AWS control plane for us-east-2b  (rate limited).
Liam O'Connor: because control plane is rate limiting, a mass detach/attach will make it worse. We're choosing DNS weight shift + host drain rather than bulk restart.
Maya Chen: monitoring: ELB 5xx rate dropped from 22% -> 5% after weight shift. Keep watch for residual errors.
Raj Patel: can we confirm no data plane corruption? Any dropped messages or KV cache issues?
Olivia Park: no evidence of data loss. Cache clients report increased latency but no evictions or miss counters that indicate corruption.
Ana (CustSuccess): status page updated: "Traffic shifted away from affected AZ; mitigation in progress. No action required from customers."
Oncall Pager: handoff: I'm taking the incident from Liam for the next 30 minutes to watch the mitigation and coordinate customer comms. Liam, leave notes?
Liam O'Connor: handing off — notes: Route53 weight set to 0 at 1767779060; ELB target groups in az-b deregistered; scaling in az-c/d +10 started. Watch for new 5xx or warm-up errors as load moves.
Maya Chen: suggestion: add short-lived IP-based NACL rule to prevent spike from legacy batch IPs that keep retrying to az-b LB. I can add if needed.
Raj Patel: positive: error budget for customers downgraded but meeting SLOs now. We'll keep routing changes for 30 minutes then gradually restore weight if ENI attach quotas normalize.
Liam O'Connor: AWS support ticket opened: SR-1254321 - ENI attach throttling in us-east-2b, asked for account-level limit increase and guidance.
SRE-Bot: AWS Support update: "Investigating internal control plane throttling; no ETA yet."
Olivia Park: follow-up: we should implement a longer-term mitigation — limit concurrent ENI attaches per host and pre-warm ENIs during scale events. Filing internal task INFRA-982.
Ana (CustSuccess): added customer note to incidents channel and flagged enterprise customers for direct outreach.
Oncall Pager: closing loop: no further immediate action, monitoring only. If 5xx > 3% re-open page.
Maya Chen: confirmed last check: 5xx at 1.8%, latency stable. Closing thread in 15m unless regress. :white_check_mark:
Liam O'Connor: thumbs: :thumbsup:
DeployBot: job #6543 resumed at 1767779400
summary: ENI attach saturation in us-east-2b caused ELB target unhealthy spikes -> Route53 weight shift and ELB drain mitigated customer impact. AWS support engaged; follow-ups filed.
